name: Vietnam
title: Vietnam's Late Opening

bars: Operating in Hanoi and HCMC (Cushman & Wakefield, Apr 2026)

tagline: Opened to foreign owners only in 2025, with state telecoms in front and a coal and hydro grid that ran short in 2023.
srcNote: Main data: EVN annual reports, government decisions and the investment portal, company releases from Viettel, FPT, CMC, NTT and AWS, and press including The Investor, VnExpress and Tuoi Tre.
